decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the lift is used.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a two storey     
          side extension, (with a motor room on the ground floor) to incorporate a     
          lift shaft and lift, because of its position, design and appearance, would 
          be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  396-400 
          London Road and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality   
          and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and 
          neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with 
          Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 1.2 (High buildings or 
          structures affecting sensitive areas) and E 2.4 - (Improvement of 
          employment premises) of the London  Borough of  Hounslow UDP, 
          Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of two storey extension to west elevation of existing building to form lift shaft and motor-room.
